name: bazi-reference-tables
description: Deterministic reference tables for BaZi (八字/四柱) and Chinese astrology software: 十神, 藏干, 十二长生, 地支关系 — plus the Simplified→Traditional term fixes that general converters get wrong.

scripts.check: node -e "import('./index.js').then(m => { const g = m.getTenGod('甲','庚'); const s = m.getTwelveStage('甲','亥'); const r = m.getBranchRelations('子','丑'); if (g !== '七杀') throw new Error('ten god mismatch: ' + g); if (s !== '长生') throw new Error('stage mismatch: ' + s); if (!r.length) throw new Error('relations empty'); console.log('ok:', g, s, r.map(x => x.relation).join('/')); })"
